steps.name: Hallmark GSEA on treated vs control DE results
caveats: One control-arm library (sample_01) has ~4x lower depth than the median; this affected the upstream DESeq2 fit, not this step directly, but note it if base_mean-derived weighting is used for tie-breaking

Gene identifiers in de_results.csv must be confirmed as HGNC gene symbols (not Ensembl IDs) before matching to the hallmark GMT; if they are Ensembl IDs, an ID conversion is needed first (the UniProt human ID mapping file in the reference store can supply Ensembl-to-symbol mapping) — check the actual gene column values before assuming symbols
With only 12000 genes profiled (not full transcriptome ~20000), hallmark gene set coverage will be partial; report the matched-gene fraction per set rather than assuming full coverage
Standard GSEA significance uses FDR q < 0.25, not q < 0.05 — do not silently tighten the threshold without reporting both
If gseapy.prerank's permutation test is unstable with only ~12000 background genes, note the effective permutation count and gene set size filters (min/max genes per set) applied
steps.context: Input is /eval-four-models-v2-without-python-enrichment-only-s1-1/data/inputs/results/de_results.csv, a DESeq2 results table (12000 genes x 8 columns: gene, base_mean, log2_fold_change, log2_fold_change_se, stat, p_value, p_adj, and one more field) for 6 treated (AD lesional) vs 6 control skin samples, unpaired, single batch. This is bulk RNA-seq from Salmon gene-level counts; the DE step is already complete, so this step starts directly from the results table as instructed. The organism is Homo sapiens, so the MSigDB human hallmark gene set collection (50 curated gene sets spanning inflammatory, metabolic, proliferative and other coherent biological states, HGNC gene symbols) staged in the reference store is the correct and only hallmark resource to use — do not substitute mouse hallmark sets or GO/oncogenic collections, which answer a different, more granular question.
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB hallmark pathways are significantly enriched among genes ranked by their differential expression in the atopic dermatitis lesional (treated) vs control skin comparison, using the existing DESeq2 results table (12000 genes)?
constraints: Use Python only, per user constraint — no R packages or R-based enrichment tools
Do not re-run differential expression; start from the existing de_results.csv as the research question specifies
Use only the MSigDB human hallmark GMT staged in the reference store; do not fabricate or hardcode a hallmark gene set list
acceptance_criteria: Loads de_results.csv (12000 x 8) from the provided results file and confirms presence of gene identifier, log2_fold_change, and p_value columns

Builds a pre-ranked gene list (one score per unique gene symbol, ties/duplicates resolved deterministically, e.g. by highest base_mean or by averaging) using a signed ranking metric combining log2 fold change and p-value significance
Loads the MSigDB human hallmark gene set collection (h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt, 50 gene sets, HGNC symbols) from the reference store and reports the exact file used
Runs gseapy.prerank (or equivalent pre-ranked GSEA) with the ranked list against the hallmark sets, using standard permutation-based FDR correction
Outputs a full results table (all 50 hallmark terms) with NES, p-value, and FDR q-value, sorted by significance, saved as CSV
Reports which hallmark pathways pass FDR < 0.25 (standard GSEA threshold) or FDR < 0.05, distinguishing the two
Produces a summary plot (e.g. barplot or dotplot of top enriched hallmark terms by NES) saved as an image file
Explicitly reports gene symbol matching rate between the DE results and the hallmark gene sets (how many DE genes mapped to at least one hallmark set) so coverage limitations are visible

plan.title: AD lesional vs control hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The DESeq2 results table (12000 genes x 8 columns: gene, base_mean, log2_fold_change, log2_fold_change_se, stat, p_value, p_adj, etc.) for the atopic-dermatitis lesional (treated) vs control skin comparison already exists, so no re-run of differential expression is needed. The research question asks specifically which hallmark pathways are enriched, which is answered by pre-ranked GSEA against the MSigDB human hallmark gene sets (50 sets, HGNC symbols) staged in the reference store. A single step ranks genes by a signed statistic (log2FC x -log10(p_value), or the DESeq2 Wald stat if present) and runs gseapy.prerank against the hallmark GMT, producing a ranked, FDR-corrected enrichment table and a plot of the top pathways. This is a single, self-contained enrichment task on a gene-level results table, so it is routed to the enrichment agent and needs no upstream transcriptomics processing.
